allowed_claim: The disabled additive provider-free v6 candidate locally closes F6-F8 and every tested runtime receipt validates under Draft 2020-12; fresh independent review, owner integration, live/provider evidence and intended-runtime acceptance remain pending.

alternatives.reason: Retaining v5 leaves three independently reproduced OPEN defects.
Add v6 under the existing CellLedger owner and leave active/protected boundaries untouched.
Editing live adapters or scheduler widens ownership and failure radius before fresh review.

benefit: Close F6-F8 without editing v1-v5 history, active runners, providers, scheduler, protected evaluation surfaces or live effects.

cost.implementation: narrow additive v6 candidate and tests
cost.maintenance: one disabled frozen version pending review

F6-V5.mechanism: Reject non-exact lowercase https prefix and all leading/trailing whitespace before urlsplit; require exact raw reconstruction after canonical path parsing; schema/runtime differential covers logical, Claude, Codex and settlement URL locations.

F7-V5.mechanism: The redirect breach condition now requires an integer before minimum 1, so null does not trigger UNKNOWN; both providers emit schema-valid ordinary fetch FAIL at seconds 0,1,599,600 and cell edges 0,1,1799,1800.

F8-V5.mechanism: Operation/status report shape and complete final-origin pairing validate before timeout, cell-window and body classification; search final_url or redirect_chain always consumes as malformed UNKNOWN_NO_REPLAY with a schema-valid stored receipt.

impact.activation_boundary: fresh independent v6 review, separate owner-controlled integration review, explicit active-runtime change, then future-triggered runtime acceptance
impact.failure_radius: additive v6 candidate, tests and evidence only

invariants.exact_fetch_prompt: Extract only source text relevant to the frozen research question. Preserve document title, publication or filing date, section or page locator, and exact quotations. Do not infer or summarize unsupported facts.

findings.issue: Parser normalization admitted raw URL spellings rejected by schema.
Ordinary web_fetch FAIL receipts were schema-invalid because null satisfied a numeric-only breach condition.
Timeout/window precedence could launder forbidden search final-origin fields into schema-invalid receipts.

selected_boundary.errors: stable PolicyError with malformed reports consumed as stored UNKNOWN_NO_REPLAY
selected_boundary.input: sealed logical web_search or web_fetch request plus provider identity and untrusted terminal provider report
selected_boundary.output: immutable translation receipt and exactly-once terminal settlement receipt
